about: The demo run. The plan and the worker edits are scripted; the tests, the checker, the merges and the budget caps are real and run on a fresh copy of sample_data/demo/repo.
goal: Add discount codes to checkout: percent and flat codes, an expiry date, applied before tax, accepted by the API.

plan.summary: Build discount codes bottom-up: the code table first, then the cart, checkout and API on top of it, with expiry and docs alongside. Each task is done when its acceptance tests in spec/ pass.

nodes.title: Discount code table
nodes.prompt: Add shop/pricing/codes.py with SAVE10 (10% off), FLAT5 ($5 off) and SPRING (20% off, expires 2026-04-30), a case-insensitive lookup() and discount_on(subtotal, code) that rounds half up and never goes below zero.

nodes.title: Document the codes
nodes.prompt: Add a Discount codes section to README.md: the codes, what each does, when it expires, and that the discount comes off before tax.

nodes.title: Cart applies a code
nodes.prompt: Give Cart apply_code(code), discount() and total(). Unknown codes raise UnknownCode. The discount must follow later changes to the cart.

nodes.title: Codes expire
nodes.prompt: Make lookup() refuse a code after its expiry date with ExpiredCode. A code still works on its last day. Accept an optional today= for testing.

nodes.title: Checkout uses the code
nodes.prompt: Show code and discount on the receipt, and tax the discounted amount.

nodes.title: API accepts a code
nodes.prompt: POST /checkout takes an optional "code". Unknown and expired codes are a 400 with a reason.

t1-r1.report: Added shop/pricing/codes.py with the three codes, lookup() and discount_on(). The spec tests for codes pass.

t2-r1.report: Added a Discount codes section with a table of codes to README.md.

t3-r1.report: Cart now has apply_code(), discount() and total(). Done.

t3-r2.report: discount() is now worked out from the current subtotal on every call instead of once in apply_code(), so items added after the code count. All cart spec tests pass.

t4-r1.report: lookup() now raises ExpiredCode for expired codes and takes today= for tests.
activity: search the repo for date handling

t4-r2.report: Changed the expiry comparison from >= to > so a code works through its last day. Expiry spec passes.

t5-r1.report: Receipts now carry code and discount, and tax is worked out on the discounted subtotal.

t6-r1.report: POST /checkout applies an optional code; unknown and expired codes return 400 with the reason.
